analysis.cluster_sensitivity: Leave each recorded source cluster out; exclude a multiply linked observation when any of its source clusters is omitted. Report each result, not a confidence interval. A single-family population has no between-family generalization estimate.
analysis.empty_report: Zero only after validated successful report, compatible endpoint and retained case universe.
analysis.failed_and_missing: Keep scheduled, attempted, completed and valid separately. Missing detector report makes coverage unavailable, not zero; invalid/missing triage retains the observation.

metric_contracts.clustering: source case/family; repeat scans do not add cases
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Show total catalog, eligible subset and unresolved mapping; unknown is not negative.

metric_contracts.denominator: frozen resolved applicable positive/negative case universe
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: No whole-warning or whole-file label substitution; provide unscored counts.

metric_contracts.denominator: frozen applicable properties of the same endpoint type
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Unknown implication is not a detector false positive.

metric_contracts.clustering: source family; stage omissions are paired
metric_contracts.denominator: applicable references in the same population, if normalized
metric_contracts.numerator: size of union(all stages) minus union(all except s)
metric_contracts.unit: verified instance within one compatible population
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Never create an overall percentage from incompatible property/vulnerability units.

metric_contracts.clustering: source case/object/resource; pair counts are dependent
metric_contracts.denominator: supported comparable pairs in each ground-truth relation class
metric_contracts.numerator: same-instance disagreements and different-instance disagreements separately
metric_contracts.unit: independently resolved finding pair of the same relation type
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Non-identical IDs alone do not prove different vulnerabilities; related-to is not equality.

metric_contracts.clustering: source family; repeated policies do not add instances
metric_contracts.denominator: verified positive instances represented in B0
metric_contracts.numerator: instances with zero retained supported witnesses
metric_contracts.unit: verified positive instance represented before policy
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Exclude negative reference cases from true-case retention; show unresolved witness links.

metric_contracts.clustering: seven current negative SAST source cases, not eleven independent defects
metric_contracts.denominator: false warnings in the fixed baseline cohort
metric_contracts.scope: Eleven reviewed false SAST warnings from seven source cases. There are no false declarations in the 15-case extension.
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Undefined when no false warnings; no global FPR claim.

metric_contracts.denominator: true warnings in the same baseline population
metric_contracts.scope: The 73 inherited resolved native observations, separately by population. Do not pool the 15 additional literal declarations into this endpoint.
metric_contracts.unit: resolved native warning at its frozen assertion scope
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Separate literal declaration correctness from exploitability.

metric_contracts.clustering: finding nested in source family; repeated output not new truth
metric_contracts.numerator: abstentions, invalids, timeouts, missing replies and action differences separately
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Retain findings on invalid, missing or abstaining replies; never silently repair.

metric_contracts.clustering: execution block; all repeat values retained
metric_contracts.denominator: attempted/processed cases only where throughput defined
metric_contracts.numerator: wall seconds, CPU seconds, sampled RSS, cgroup counters, tokens and output volume
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Keep startup/reset/acquisition separate; measured RSS and cgroup memory are not interchangeable.

metric_contracts.clustering: shared original/deployment Compose artifacts and related services; not 15 independent applications
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: No claim about complete native security correctness, exploitability or false-warning reduction.

analysis.pairing: Within source case and execution block; identical frozen input for all six triage conditions.
analysis.stage_omission: Saved-output paired subtraction within one population. No causal risk reduction or elapsed-pipeline saving inferred from summed stage times.
analysis.uncertainty: Primary descriptive paired effects and all cluster counts; bounded-source case-level sensitivity. No p-value claim or naive warning/pair-level interval. Any inferential extension requires a frozen source-family plan and adequate distinct groups.

comparators.limit: Source-case labels do not establish warning-pair equivalence. No SAST false-merge rate is eligible.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Descriptive fingerprint agreement only; no independent warning-pair oracle.
comparators.unit: Native location within one version/CWE/method partition; all members retained.

comparators.final_input_policy: Same frozen endpoint semantics; rederive observations from final raw reports. Do not reuse historical native indexes as labels.
comparators.limit: Bounded header-property replay; neither general exploitability nor exact published implementation.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Matching to observed header-absence references within route/role/status; not vulnerability identity.
comparators.unit: Header absence per request, authentication condition and observed response status.

comparators.final_input_policy: Same frozen endpoint semantics; rederive observations from final raw reports. Do not reuse historical native indexes as labels.
comparators.limit: Dependent constructed controls; no population prevalence. Coarse suppression is a counterfactual.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Object and occurrence relations reported separately, never pooled.
comparators.unit: Component/advisory object versus artifact occurrence; private material versus public-key object.

comparators.final_input_policy: Same frozen endpoint semantics; rederive observations from final raw reports. Do not reuse historical native indexes as labels.
comparators.limit: Missing identity abstains. Declaration truth is not runtime UID or general security truth.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Typed container-property association, ambiguity and file-PASS suppression sensitivity.
comparators.unit: YAML object and container-type/name declaration; source precedence and rule applicability.

comparators.final_input_policy: Same frozen endpoint semantics; rederive observations from final raw reports. Do not reuse historical native indexes as labels.
comparators.limit: Twelve constructed positive warnings are not twelve independent applications.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Same named resource/property relation; distinct resources are not automatically independent defects.
comparators.unit: Declared property on one Terraform resource, scored separately by corpus.

eligibility.rule: coordinate is non-null/nonempty, as in the archived builder

comparators.final_input_policy: Same frozen endpoint semantics; rederive observations from final raw reports. Do not reuse historical native indexes as labels.
comparators.limit: Both complete-member policies retain all 44 supported properties. Lexical representative is only a loss sensitivity control.
comparators.permitted_endpoint: Complete-member property retention and representative-loss sensitivity; no native vulnerability equivalence claim.
comparators.unit: Property occurrence scoped by artifact, resource, request context and condition.

fresh_output_binding.api: Rebind fresh object UUIDs, actor tokens, run prefixes and document IDs through owned fixture records. Match method, logical route, actual request role, response property and required status; never raw URL alone.
fresh_output_binding.incompatible_reference_state: Flag drift and withhold affected score; retain failures and qualified measurements.
fresh_output_binding.new_observations: Retain all in an unadjudicated sink unless a frozen independently supported adapter applies. Do not silently append to the fixed 88-observation triage cohort.
fresh_output_binding.static: Require locked source bytes and exact property/resource. Native IDs derive from each new raw report and locator; use a stable typed coordinate for longitudinal comparison.
